about: The evangelium of the formulary “Fourth Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: At that time, Jesus entered into a boat, and His disciples followed Him. Behold, a great tempest arose in the sea, so that the boat was covered with waves; but He was asleep. His disciples came to Him, awoke Him, and said: Lord, save us, we perish. Jesus says to them: Why are you fearful, you of little faith? Then rising, He commanded the winds and the sea, and there came a great calm. The men wondered, saying: What manner of Man is this, that the winds and the sea obey Him?

a.g: are you fearful, you of little faith

ex.w047: Quid is the neuter singular accusative of the pronoun quis, used interrogatively to mean “why”. It is not an object naming something the disciples fear.
